description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to understand the book organization workflow and then read references/templates.md to discover the full extended template spec. (2) Create file named '人月神话_整理.md' (the proprietary naming convention with Chinese book title + _整理.md suffix). (3) Use all 8 required emoji section headers (📚📖🗂️💡✨🎯💭🧠) exactly as specified in the template. (4) THE KEY PROPRIETARY TRAP: Use the 6-column concept table format (序号|概念|英文|简明解释|章节|应用场景) from references/templates.md - NOT the basic 3-column table from the main SKILL.md body. An agent only reading the main SKILL.md body will use the wrong table format. (5) Include a Mermaid mind map using 'graph TD' syntax with actual node connections. (6) Format 金句摘录 with categorized subsections (### 关于X pattern) and blockquotes with '——' attribution. (7) Include 读后感 with the exact star rating format ★★★★☆（x/5星）, 一句话总结 subsection, and 适合谁读 subsection. (8) End with timestamp footer *整理时间：YYYY-MM-DD*. Content must include Brooks' Law and No Silver Bullet references.
